heroMedia.alt: Jordan, owner of Brewing Buddha in Pinecrest, talks about working with Button Up Media

snapshot.h2: In the Gables, your photos do the talking
paragraphsHtml: Coral Gables was planned as "The City Beautiful," and a Board of Architects still reviews how buildings and signs look. You cannot out-shout the restaurant next door with a bigger sign, so most new guests find you online first.

One day can bring client lunches from the Ponce de Leon Boulevard offices, residents planning a celebration, and visitors to the Biltmore and the University of Miami. Expectations are high, and many guests search and decide in Spanish.

proof.bodyHtml: A quirky coffee shop and art space just south of the Gables, known for its creative lattes. Its content has drawn 24M+ video views, led by a butter coffee video from February 2025.

steps.h2: What we'd do first in Coral Gables

items.title: Photos that look as good as the room
items.bodyHtml: Food, dining room and service shot by our crew and kept consistent across Google, Instagram and your site. Plated dishes are usually captured before doors open. See our content service.

items.title: A complete Google listing with fresh reviews
items.bodyHtml: Correct categories, a current menu, a working reservation link and recent reviews answered in each guest's language, through our Google Business Profile service.

items.title: Make the lunch booking take seconds
items.bodyHtml: Office lunches get planned fast. A clear menu and a reservation or private-room inquiry that works in one tap on a phone wins the table first.

pricingHtml: Most restaurants invest $1,500 to $5,000 a month for a coordinated program. Website builds are a one-time $1,500 or $2,000.

faqs.q: Do you work with restaurants in Coral Gables?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with restaurants, bars and cafes across Miami-Dade. Our closest case study is Brewing Buddha in nearby Pinecrest.

faqs.q: Can you shoot without disrupting lunch service?
faqs.a: Yes. Shoots are scheduled around your service, and most food and drink content is captured before doors open.

faqs.q: Can you reply to reviews in Spanish?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team is bilingual, so review replies, captions, ads and your website can run in English, Spanish or both.

faqs.q: Can you help us book more private events?
faqs.a: Yes. We run Google Ads built around private-event inquiries and reservations, with conversion tracking so you can see what each inquiry costs.

cta.h2: Want the Gables to find you first?
cta.body: Juan will look at how your restaurant shows up online today and tell you what we would fix first. Free, in English or Spanish.
